summary: Iteration 4: tested all 6 new features (login remember flag, admin search/sort, PT guide links, file inline/attachment download, workout expires_at, cron plan-expiry + session-reminders). Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed. Frontend: all data-testids present and functional; UI integration verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1095 lines — approaching the 700-line split guideline; consider modularising (cron, files, auth, admin) into separate routers.

Cron idempotency inserts a cron_runs doc BEFORE kicking off the background task; if the asyncio.create_task crashes before completion, the duplicate guard will block retries. Consider marking completed only after success or allowing retry on failed runs.

In _process_session_reminders, after send_session_reminder returns False (e.g., Resend 422), the reminder flag is NOT set — this means every hourly cron will retry sending until the session passes. For undeliverable recipients this generates perpetual 422s in logs. Consider recording an attempt_count and backing off.
